clock.ts.why: the real Clock itself: every other read goes through it or Sys

progress.ts.why: a progress record's updatedAt and its rate: display

laptop/commands.ts.why: when a status was read and a screen drawn: display

laptop/main.ts.why: the laptop's Clock: passed on to the lines here

laptop/owner.ts.why: the time a signed statement carries; the box judges its 5 minutes

laptop/pair.ts.why: when a box was paired: a label

laptop/screen.ts.why: how long a workspace has waited to save: display

laptop/update.ts.why: when the laptop last looked for an update: a step only looks sooner or later

actionskey.ts.why: a GitHub App JWT's iat and the clock offset GitHub reports: GitHub judges the JWT

github.ts.why: a GitHub App JWT's iat, the offset GitHub reports, and a failure's time for a status line

connectflow.ts.why: JWTs, labels on a pending connect, and the waits for GitHub and a new key: a step only ends a wait, which changes nothing and says so

watchdog.ts.why: a JWT, and whether the hourly workflows check and the last run are recent: a row's SKIP and display

away.ts.why: days until a date and recent logins: display

awaychecks.ts.why: how long ago the loop's last request and beat were: rows that say OK with a time

checks.ts.why: the guard's and the workspaces state's freshness (a stale read FAILs, so a step fails closed) and how recent a loss or a moved log is: display

rows/guard.ts.why: the guard's record's freshness: a stale read FAILs, so a step fails closed

cli.ts.why: the answers envelope's at, for a usage error, a rename and every answer: a label

ops.ts.why: screens and log reads, the undo's lock time, a pin's label, the hourly line for an unreadable watch, and the rollback watch's wall time: decideWatch uses it only for a watch with no mono count (v2.6.1's, or a clock it can't read), capped at 3 h. Remove's op record takes its start, end and phase times from it, for people to read; no deadline or lapse rests on them. A stale or stopped remove's end time, and the update lock's note of when remove took it, too.

install.ts.why: installedAt labels, the lock's time, and the wait for Tailscale to start: a step only waits less or more

stopstart.ts.why: a drain's and a stop's time labels (the drain is judged by its boot uuid), and how long stop waits for the loop: a step only waits less or more

loadcmd.ts.why: the load command's now for its session's labels and freshness: display and a refusal to start

queue.ts.why: when the queue was read and a run's queued time when GitHub gives none: the scheduler's order

kinds.ts.why: the scheduler's now: when slots became ready or busy, an idle VM's turn, and when a VM was told to give way: a step only reorders a choice, gives an idle VM's turn away or ends a wait for a VM to go; no running job is ended

gate.ts.why: the workspaces gate's now: the state must be within 3 minutes either way, so a step fails closed

workspace/agent.ts.why: a request's time (the guard judges it), the wait for an answer, the workspaces state's freshness (fails closed both ways), and progress labels

workspace/pass.ts.why: the workspaces pass's now: its beat and when a failed fence proof is tried again, both timers, either way of a step

passes/v2.ts.why: the logins keeper's minute: a timer

passes/keeping.ts.why: the wall part of a Moment: a pending change and an outcome lapse on the wall clock too, and mono and the boot hold them to their limits

core/passes.ts.why: when each guard pass starts and ends: a pass's timing for its row

core/events.ts.why: an event's time and id, and the minute windows of its rate limits: a step only shortens or lengthens a window

core/spool.ts.why: a stale temp name in a spool (removing it early costs a resend) and the spool pass's time budget (a step leaves requests for the next pass)

core/child.ts.why: an op's end time and spawn time, and the 30 s a new job has to take its lease: a step only changes that grace; a free lease is the proof. Op deadlines are on mono

guard.ts.why: the guard record's time, its full pass timer, and the freshness readers check (a stale record fails closed). A VM start judges a loss by mono and the boot too

loopwatch.ts.why: a restart record's time label, and vmStarting, which only puts off a one-time move of Softnet for a loop older than v2.5.1 while a VM starts. Whether a beat has gone quiet is judged on mono alone

loop.ts.why: the loop's labels, beats, timers and state times for screens, pull and peer waits, give-way and sampling timers. Job ceilings and vmMaxHours are on mono alone, the drain on the boot uuid, and a VM start's loss on mono and the wall clock both

cmd/daemons.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the load session's wanted read and the workspaces hold's freshness for the loop, which fails closed both ways. The guard's step-down proof reads no clock: a new guard record file

cmd/job.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the now job timings' acceptance rows are read against: display

cmd/logins.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the now the logins screen counts back from: display

cmd/status.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the now for status's recent-logins line: display

cmd/workspace.ts.why: moved from cli.ts: the workspaces screen's now, and the agent commands' now for the state's freshness, which fails closed both ways, and their waits for the guard's answer, which give up and change nothing

shell.ts.why: the agent shell's refusal envelope's at: a label
